[package]
name = "device-ai"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = ["yurvon-screamo"]
description = "Rust library for native, on-device AI APIs"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/yurvon-screamo/tauri-plugin-device-ai-apis"
keywords = ["ai", "speech", "vision", "llm", "ocr"]
categories = ["api-bindings", "multimedia"]
readme = "README.md"

[features]
default = ["speech", "vision", "text", "llm"]
speech = []
vision = []
text = []
llm = []

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0"
thiserror = "2"
base64 = "0.22"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.0"
features = ["v4"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.58"
features = ["Foundation", "Foundation_Collections", "Storage_Streams", "Media_SpeechRecognition", "Media_SpeechSynthesis", "Media_Ocr", "Globalization", "Graphics_Imaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2-speech = "0.3"
objc2-av-foundation = "0.3"
objc2-vision = "0.3"
objc2-core-image = "0.3"
block2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2]
version = "0.6"
features = ["exception", "catch-all"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
features = ["NSString", "NSArray", "NSData", "NSError", "NSDictionary", "NSValue"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-natural-language]
version = "0.3"
features = ["NLLanguage", "NLLanguageRecognizer"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3"
features = ["NSSpeechSynthesizer"]

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-device-ai-apis"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = ["yurvon-screamo"]
description = "A Tauri plugin for cross-platform device AI capabilities including speech, vision, and text processing"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
exclude = ["/examples", "/dist-js", "/guest-js", "/node_modules"]
links = "tauri-plugin-device-ai-apis"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/yurvon-screamo/tauri-plugin-device-ai-apis"
keywords = ["tauri", "plugin", "ai", "speech", "vision"]
categories = ["api-bindings", "multimedia"]

[workspace]
members = ["crates/device-ai"]

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.10.2"

[dependencies.device-ai]
version = "0.2.0"
path = "crates/device-ai"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
version = "2.5.3"
features = ["build"]
